bio: I love helping people to get things done, working at the intersection of community, technology, leadership and fun. Community builder and developer by passion, Developer Relations by profession.

At Google, I lead the global Google Developer Experts (GDE) program, after leading Dev Community Operations & Data and dev community programs across Europe. Before joining Google, I was an Android developer and systems administrator.
I believe in the learn-build-share loop: organizing conferences like ICM Summit and WhyMCA, speaking at international conferences, mentoring, and blogging at rainbowbreeze.it.
